question: I'm expecting a baby next month. What leave am I entitled to?
key_facts: mothers are entitled to 16 weeks of maternity leave
fathers may take up to 4 weeks of paternity leave

question: I joined Acme two months ago and I'm still on probation. How much notice do I give if I resign, and can I take my annual leave yet?
key_facts: the handbook's annual leave entitlement applies to confirmed employees

question: I've worked at Acme for 4 years as a non-manager and my contract doesn't mention notice. How much notice do I need to give?
key_facts: Acme's notice period after confirmation is 1 month for employees below manager grade
the statutory default for 2 to under 5 years of service is 2 weeks and applies only when no notice period has been agreed

question: Acme gives 20 days of annual leave, right? And how many can I carry forward?
key_facts: up to 7 days can be carried forward

question: Is it okay to work from home three days a week at Acme?
key_facts: working from home is limited to up to 2 days per week
subject to team and manager approval

question: My boss wants me to come in on National Day. Do I get anything extra for that?
key_facts: an extra day's salary at the basic rate, or a day off in lieu

question: I'm a non-workman earning $3,000 a month in basic salary. Am I entitled to statutory overtime pay?

expected_sources.title: Hours of Work, Overtime and Rest Days

key_facts: no, because non-workmen are covered for overtime only if their monthly basic salary is $2,600 or less

question: What happens to my unused leave at the end of the year?
key_facts: up to 7 days can be carried forward
carried-forward days must be used by 31 March or they lapse

question: If I resign in April, will Acme pay me out for the 7 days of leave I carried forward?
key_facts: the sources do not say whether unused leave is paid out on resignation

question: Give me a quick comparison of Acme's annual leave, sick leave and childcare leave against the legal minimums.
key_facts: annual leave: Acme gives 16 days versus a statutory 7 to 14 days
sick leave: 14 days outpatient and 60 days hospitalisation
childcare leave: 6 days, plus 2 extra company-paid infant care days at Acme
